question: The National Unity Day is celebrated in India on the birth anniversary of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Unity Day:

 
 
• The day is also called the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas.
 
• It was celebrated for the first time on 31st October 2014.
 
• The is celebrated to commemorate the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
 
• The theme for National Unity Day 2020 was Unity in diversity is better than, unity in similarities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel:

 
 
• He was born on 31st October 1875 in Nadiad, Gujarat.
 
• He is known as the *Iron Man of India* for playing an important role in the integration and unification of princely states into the Indian union.
 
• He was the first home minister and deputy prime minister of India.
 
• He also headed Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights, Committee on Minorities and Tribal and Excluded Areas and Provincial Constitution Committee in the constituent assembly.
 
• He was an active part of Kheda Satyagraha in 1918 and Bardoli Satyagraha in 1928.
 
• He was given the title of *Sardar *by the Women of Bardoli.
